issues.description: The problem specification (and solution) expect a Stock.emptyStock() method, but the template Stock class provides a method named clearInventory(). This naming mismatch for the same conceptual operation will confuse students implementing the exercise (they may look for emptyStock as required by the spec/tests but find clearInventory in the template).
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method clearInventory() to emptyStock() (or provide an emptyStock() wrapper that calls clearInventory()) so the template matches the problem statement and the solution. Alternatively, update the problem statement to use clearInventory() consistently, but prefer renaming the template for consistency with the UML/spec and solution.
